程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.auth

类 AuthUI

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.auth.AuthUI
public class AuthUI extends Object
Authentication UI module providing Login, Registration (TA/MO), Change Password, and Logout dialogs. Aligned with Backlog TA-01 (Account Registration) and TA-02 (Login & Session).

    • showLoginDialog

      public static String[] showLoginDialog(JFrame parent, TA_Recruitment_software.RecruitmentSystemContext context)
      Show the login dialog. Returns [token, roleName] on success, null on cancel/failure. If there are valid persistent sessions, shows a dialog to choose which one to use.
